summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser as requested. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError (a direct Exception subclass). Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py, a parametrized module-scoped-fixture test covering every valid form and every invalid branch, plus a Literal TypeError check and the exception-hierarchy check. Results: 42 passed across the new tests and the existing test/test_path.py, run with the prepared venv interpreter. No existing files were modified and nothing was committed. Choices beyond the spec: list walking is done manually because Collection is not an allowed import; a malformed list node (missing rdf:first or rdf:rest) and a cyclic rdf:rest chain both raise SHACLPathError. No formatter or linter was available in the venv; I checked that no line exceeds 88 characters.
